title: Wandering Tasks
description: The wandering trader now gives fetch quests with actual worthwhile rewards
body:
**Press Shift + Right Click to get a quest from a trader**
![Quest given](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0735bbf91477e3f298b051cc3197df16f3874133.png)

Gives simple fetch quests to the wandering trader, making him more useful and giving players some extra goals and reasons to explore. Rewards range from basic resources, to completely unique items:

![book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3aaa314d34b60722602443fbd760343e3bd4a205.gif)
![sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dac739444410bae3b0450a01b5a32e20ffb5866c.gif)

It also adds a scroll to temporarily summon the trader that you can buy off the Cartographer:
![Traders scroll](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ed5fd7d76e9c78b9f71db03bc325603f8c0430d.png)

There are total of 3 tiers of quests/rewards 

if you have any issues or suggestions, you can contact me at ratralfiofanov@gmail.com
